decisions: Data & Training Pipeline: Determining how much effort allows us to ship.

requirements.description: Does the review say massive data is non-negotiable? Can we get away with a small, high-quality instruction dataset?
Do we absolutely have to pre-train from scratch, or does the survey point to fine-tuning pre-trained models (Two-Stage pipeline) as a viable path?
Are automated metrics like POPE or MME reliable enough to be our main unit test, or do we need humans?
How hard is it to add new modalities to existing models(like Audio) later if we pick a specific architecture now?
Does instruction tuning tends to make the model 'forget' its original text-only capabilities?
